quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungarian paprika, the spice that defines so much of Hungarian cuisine, was actually brought to Hungary by the Turks in the 16th century. Today, Hungary produces some of the world's finest paprika, especially from the town of Szeged and Kalocsa. The spice transformed Hungarian cooking so completely that most people now think of it as originally Hungarian!

short_read.title: Why Do Hummingbirds Hum?
short_read.teaser: These tiny jewels of the bird world create their distinctive sound not with their voices, but with their incredibly fast wing beats. Discover the fascinating physics behind the hummingbird's signature sound.

medium_read.title: The Secret Lives of Tide Pools
medium_read.teaser: The rocky shores of the Pacific Northwest are home to miniature worlds teeming with colorful sea stars, anemones, and other fascinating creatures. Learn how these tough little animals survive between two worlds of land and sea.

long_read.title: The Victorian Language of Flowers
long_read.teaser: In the 19th century, people communicated entire conversations through carefully chosen flower arrangements, with each bloom carrying a specific meaning. This charming practice allowed Victorians to express feelings they couldn't speak aloud.

port_angeles.title: Black-Tailed Deer at Hurricane Ridge
port_angeles.description: September is a wonderful time to spot black-tailed deer at Hurricane Ridge, as they're especially active during the early fall. These graceful animals are often seen grazing in the meadows, and bucks begin showing off their antlers this time of year. The cooler weather makes for perfect viewing conditions on the ridge.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's wings can beat up to ___ times per second during normal flight.
puzzle_1.correct_response: Exactly right! That's incredibly fast — faster than our eyes can even see!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is 80 beats per second — almost too fast to imagine!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: The answer is 80 times per second! That's so fast it creates the humming sound we hear.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: During courtship dives, some hummingbird species can beat their wings even faster — up to 200 times per second! Their wing muscles make up about 30% of their body weight.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'butterfly'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Wonderful! Pillangó is indeed the Hungarian word for butterfly — such a pretty word for a pretty creature!
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The answer is pillangó! Madár means bird, virág means flower, and méhecske means little bee.
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: The Hungarian word 'pillangó' is thought to come from the word 'pilláz' meaning 'to flutter.' Hungary is home to about 160 species of butterflies, including the beautiful Swallowtail.

puzzle_3.question: What ocean mammal can hold its breath for up to 90 minutes?
puzzle_3.correct_response: That's right! Sperm whales are incredible divers, descending to amazing depths in search of giant squid. They're the deep-diving champions of the whale world!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: It's the sperm whale! These amazing creatures dive deeper than any other whale — sometimes over a mile down — holding their breath for up to 90 minutes while hunting for giant squid.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Sperm whales have the largest brain of any animal on Earth, weighing up to 20 pounds. They use echolocation to hunt in the dark depths of the ocean, producing the loudest sounds made by any animal.
